definitions.explanation: Describes extremely cruel or inhumane acts or behavior, involving deliberate infliction of suffering.

examples.japanese: {残虐|ざんぎゃく}な⟦{行為|こうい}→行為：10021_koui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{許|ゆる}さない→許す：02325_yurusu⟧。
examples.english: We will not tolerate cruel acts.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{残虐|ざんぎゃく}な⟦シーン→シーン：08914_shiin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: That movie has many brutal scenes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{残虐|ざんぎゃく}な⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{数多|かずおお}く→数多く：12948_kazuooku⟧⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Many atrocious incidents are recorded throughout history.

notes:
USAGE:
{残虐|ざんぎゃく} describes severe cruelty that goes beyond ordinary unkindness. It is used for serious contexts such as war crimes, torture, and extreme violence.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {残虐|ざんぎゃく}な⟦{行為|こうい}→行為：10021_koui⟧ (cruel act)
- {残虐|ざんぎゃく}な⟦{犯罪|はんざい}→犯罪：03569_hanzai⟧ (brutal crime)
- {残虐性|ざんぎゃくせい} (cruelty; brutality — noun form)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{残酷|ざんこく}→残酷：13201_zankoku⟧ (cruel) is similar but slightly more common in everyday use. {残虐|ざんぎゃく} implies a more extreme degree of cruelty.
